limitations: Closed-loop fixed workers; one observed run per point, not an arrival-rate test.
Cache RPS is not model generation speed; no token-rate or monetary savings claim.
Header durations are walltime, not CPU; direct/gateway differences are not CPU costs.
Concurrent semantic fallback can create later exact hits; dispositions show this.
Sampler, client and servers share hardware; CPU ticks and RSS samples are coarse.
Repeated real prompts can reuse backend KV caches independently of gateway caching.
Single observed final trial per point; run order and shared host variability prevent precise causal overhead attribution.
A first sampler omitted Ollama descendants on this kernel; those resource data were excluded and all final trials rerun.
Semantic serving remains finite reviewed-vocabulary reuse; the final unseen-wording audit has zero production positive recall.
